name: Andaz West Hollywood
insider_take: This stylish Sunset Strip sanctuary perfectly captures West Hollywood's rock 'n' roll glamour with a sophisticated modern twist.
whats_special: Located directly on the legendary Sunset Strip, Andaz West Hollywood occupies the site of the former Continental Hyatt House, famously known as the "Riot House" where rock legends like Led Zeppelin and The Who once partied. The hotel's design celebrates this musical heritage while offering contemporary luxury with floor-to-ceiling windows showcasing stunning city and Hollywood Hills views.
pro_tip: Book a corner suite facing south for unobstructed views of the Hollywood sign and downtown LA skyline – perfect for those Instagram-worthy sunset shots over the Strip.
dont_miss: The rooftop pool deck offers 360-degree views of Los Angeles, while the hotel sits within walking distance of iconic venues like the Whisky a Go Go, The Roxy, and Viper Room. You're also just minutes from Melrose Avenue's trendy shopping and the designer boutiques of Robertson Boulevard.
pros: Prime Sunset Strip location with easy access to entertainment venues
Modern boutique design with contemporary West Hollywood aesthetic
Rooftop pool and bar with panoramic city views
Hyatt Prive program benefits including upgrades and amenities
cons: Urban location with potential street noise
Limited parking availability in busy entertainment district
